Sixsan was clever from the start, her little head spinning faster than a windmill. 
She knew one thing for certain. When humans are happy, their hands loosen, and tasty treats always follow. 
So wherever there was celebration, be it weddings, new homes, exam successes, there was Sixsan, tail high, eyes bright. 
Her coat gleamed like polished mirror, fat and glossy from feasting. 
Everyone in the village adored her cheerful, well-fed look and called her the Lucky Cat. They named her "Sixsan" for smooth sailing and good fortune. 
And true enough, every time someone called her name, a delicious treat would be waiting. And Sixsan would turn into the happiest cat in the world.
